origine_fr: La nourriture 饣 et 我, qui donnait le son : on le prononçait autrefois presque comme 饿. Aujourd'hui, wǒ et è ne sonnent plus pareil. 饣 dit qu'on parle de manger : avoir faim.
origine_en: Food 饣 plus 我, which gave the sound: it was once pronounced almost like 饿. Today wǒ and è no longer sound alike. 饣 tells you this is about eating: to be hungry.
